description: Create Windows To Go and bootable Windows installation/WinPE USB media
post_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "WinToUSB executable was not found after Inno Setup extraction: $exe" }
notes: The Free Edition is restricted to personal, non-commercial home use. Scoop extracts the Inno Setup application payload without running the vendor installer or registering the normal Windows installation. WinToUSB may require administrator rights when creating or cloning bootable media because those operations modify disk partitions and boot components.
